overview_description.description: Charles is an AI-powered conversational commerce platform that helps brands manage customer engagement through messaging apps. It is a SaaS platform focused on conversational commerce and customer engagement. It enables brands to automate marketing, sales, and support through messaging channels like WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger using AI-driven chat solutions. The platform helps businesses improve conversion, retention, and customer interaction through real-time personalized conversations.
